Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1377

2025-04-22
Claim reported by the insured's representing attorney following a sideswipe that occurred while the insured's vehicle
was changing lanes. Initial notice received and file opened for review.
2025-05-02
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver on the policy in force at the time of
loss. No coverage questions have been identified at this stage.
2025-05-13
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene. Responding officers and two
other sources confirm the claimant's presence in the car.
2025-05-29
Photographs submitted by the claimant show the damage on the vehicle, and the pattern of the impact is consistent
with the described side-to-side contact during a lane change.
2025-06-07
Inspected the insured vehicle and found no indication of earlier damage to the same panels. Repair estimate is bieng
prepared based on the current findings.
2025-07-20
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided medical records showing a wrist fracture. The injury is a plausible
result of a collision of this type.
2025-08-22
Took a recorded statement from the claimant. The account of the lane change and contact was consistent with what
was given during the first notice and in the prior phone call.
2025-09-17
Reviewed medical records noting that the claimant had a minor strain in the same wrist area several years ago, which
healed completely with no lasting effects. Records do not show any ongoing condition linked to that event.
2025-11-01
Treatment after the accident followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits that became less
frequent as the claimant's range of motion improved.
2025-11-11
No independent witnesses have come forward to describe the lane change. The file relies on the photographs, the
police report, and the physical evidence on the vehicles.
2025-11-14
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the satrt of coverage. The policy effective dates and the loss date
are consistent with the reported timeline.
2025-11-20
Current assessment supports moving forward with the injury and property claims under review. Settlement evaluation
to follow once the attorney submits the final medical billing summary.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
